packageRules.description: Keep Dockerfile base-image digests pinned and fresh (builder + distroless runtime) (#148).
OpenTelemetry Go modules release in lockstep — group across all update types so a bump is never a partial set.
Prometheus client/common/exporter-toolkit libraries are co-versioned — group them into one PR.

No major updates for go.yaml.in/yaml: the major is part of the module path, so v2 -> v3 is a different module, not an upgrade. Renovate got this wrong in #527 and added v3 to the direct require block alongside v2 with no importer at all. Migrating is pointless anyway — vendored prometheus/common and exporter-toolkit both require v2, so pointing our one first-party import (scripts/docgen/compose_reference_test.go) at v3 would ADD a second yaml module rather than replace one. Revisit only when those dependencies move (#533).
